privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: Personal data collected on the website, purposes, recipients, retention period and your rights.
privacy.intro: How we use and protect the information you entrust to us.

s1.title: Data controller
s1.body:
Data collected on this website is processed by {agency}, {address}. For any question: {email}.

Processing complies with Ivorian Law No. 2013-450 of 19 June 2013 on the protection of personal data.

s2.title: Data collected
s2.body:
- Quote request: first and last name, email, phone, WhatsApp, country of residence and trip details (destination, dates, travellers, budget, preferences).
- Contact form: name, email, phone and message.
- Booking: traveller details and booked services.

We only collect the information needed to handle your request.

s3.title: Purposes
s3.body: Your data is used to answer your requests, prepare and follow up your trip (quote, booking, visa), contact you about it and meet our legal and accounting obligations. It is neither sold nor used for advertising without your consent.

s4.title: Recipients
s4.body: Only the agency team members handling your file have access to it. Some data is shared, when necessary, with your trip's service providers (airlines, hotels, rental companies, insurers) and with consular authorities for a visa application.

s5.title: Retention period
s5.body: Data is kept for as long as needed to handle your request and carry out your trip, then for the periods required by law, notably for accounting records. A request with no follow-up is deleted after [to be completed].

s6.title: Cookies

s7.title: Security
s7.body: Exchanges with the website are encrypted (HTTPS), access to data is restricted to authorised people and forms are protected against automated submissions.

s8.title: Your rights
s8.body: You may request access to your data, its correction or deletion, and object to its processing, by writing to {email}. You may also contact the Côte d'Ivoire Telecommunications/ICT Regulatory Authority (ARTCI), the personal data protection authority.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.metaDescription: Terms and conditions of sale: quotes, booking, prices, payment, changes, cancellation and formalities.
terms.intro: Terms applicable to the services offered by the agency on the website and by its advisors.

s1.title: Purpose
s1.body: These terms govern the sale of services by {agency}: flight tickets, tours, accommodation, vehicle rental, transfers, activities, visa assistance and events. Any booking implies their acceptance.

s2.title: Quotes
s2.body: Quote requests are free and without obligation. The agency's proposal states the services, the total price and its validity date; after that date, prices and availability must be confirmed again.

s3.title: Booking
s3.body: The client accepts the proposal online, from the link received by email, or with an advisor. The booking is final after written confirmation by the agency and payment of the deposit stated in the proposal. Services are subject to the availability of providers.

s4.title: Prices
s4.body: Prices are given in CFA francs (FCFA), the only contractual currency; amounts shown in euros, dollars or pounds are for information. Unless stated otherwise, they are per person and only include the services described. The price may be revised before departure if taxes or transport costs change, under the conditions set out in the proposal.

s5.title: Payment
s5.body: The deposit and balance are paid according to the schedule in the proposal, at the agency or by the payment methods given by the advisor. Failure to pay the balance on time may lead to cancellation of the booking, under the conditions of the “Cancellation by the client” section.

s6.title: Changes by the client
s6.body: Any change request (dates, travellers, services) is considered subject to availability. Fees charged by providers (airlines, hotels) and any agency handling fees are payable by the client.

s7.title: Cancellation by the client
s7.body: Cancellation must be notified in writing. Cancellation fees depend on the providers' conditions and the cancellation date; they are stated in the proposal. Non-refundable tickets and visa fees are not refunded.

s8.title: Cancellation by the agency
s8.body: The agency may cancel a tour or group trip if the minimum number of participants is not reached or in case of force majeure. The client is then refunded the amounts paid, or offered an equivalent service.

s9.title: Formalities
s9.body: Each traveller must hold a valid passport and the visas, vaccinations and documents required by the countries visited. The agency informs and assists the client, but the issuing of a visa is solely the decision of the consular authorities: a refusal cannot be attributed to the agency.

s10.title: Insurance
s10.body: Travel insurance (assistance, repatriation, cancellation) is strongly recommended and can be taken out through the agency.

s11.title: Liability
s11.body: The agency is responsible for the proper performance of the services booked with it. It cannot be held liable in case of fault by the client, unforeseeable act of a third party or force majeure (bad weather, strikes, decisions by the authorities).

s12.title: Complaints
s12.body: Any complaint should be sent in writing to {email}, if possible within 30 days of your return.

s13.title: Governing law
s13.body: These terms are governed by Ivorian law. Failing an amicable settlement, the courts of Abidjan have jurisdiction.
